full_judgment: 50. On perusal of the sketch-map, it appears that there was an office of Bairaura Samity, several shops and houses beside the place of occurrence. The locals i.e. PWs 8, 9, 11 and 12 stated that the convict petitioners were not present at the time and place of occurrence. Furthermore, one Abu Syed lodged the GD No. 28 dated 1-1-2001. He was not examined by the prosecution. The tempo driver who took the victim to Hospital as stated by PWs 2 to 7 were also not examined by the prosecution. PW 6 Kamrul stated that Abdul Khaleque of village Mazalihaji along with 2/4 persons were present at the place of occurrence. PW 7 Tota Mia is the brother of PW 1. He admitted that 20/50 persons were sitting in front of the shops at the time of occurrence except the convict petitioners. The local shop keepers were also present there. PW 8 Abul Kashem stated that there were many shops near the place of occurrence and many people assembled at the place of occurrence. The prosecution did not examine those witnesses who were present at the time and place of occurrence or near the place of occurrence. Non- examination of those witnesses give rise an adverse presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act, 1872 against the prosecution.
